hero.lead: Salsa, bachata and more: every night out in Italy in one place, updated day by day. We're building it right now — starting from Milan.

mapTeaser.description: See where people are dancing tonight, night by night, in real time — freely, no sign-in needed. We'll only ask you to sign in with your Google account if you want to like a night or say you're going. At first it covers only Milan: we're opening it city by city.
mapTeaser.hint: No login to look around — only to like or join a night.

count.title: How to dance bachata
count.subtitle: Four beats, then it starts over
count.explanation: The music runs in groups of four beats, the same throughout the song. On the first four you move to the right: a step on 1, 2 and 3, and on 4 you don't step but do a tap — you set your foot next to the other one, without shifting weight onto it, and that's where the hip movement comes from. On the next four you do it all again to the left: steps on 5, 6 and 7, tap on 8. Soft knees, count in time, and you're already on the floor.

partners.titleHighlight: We've got great news for you.

partners.instagramHint: Want to be among the first? Message us: we're starting from Milan.

events.label: Organisers and socials
events.copy: Socials, festivals and one-nighters: one single place where every date ends up.

venue.label: Venues and clubs
venue.copy: Your Latin nights on the map of the people already looking for them, the same evening.

school.label: Schools and instructors

support.text: We're building Ballastasera as a team of two, in the evenings, between one job and the next — because we dance too, and a place like this didn't exist yet. If you like the project, buy us a coffee: it helps us keep it alive.
